header.name: Asset Design Management
header.description:
Copied from Asset Management v0.0.6

Asset Designs are abstracted definitions of Assets (aka details) and/or Asset Groups (aka assemblies)

props.description: An Asset Design represents an abstract definition of an asset, generally, when an engineering drawing exists for a particular asset - that would be the "design". Generic asset (i.e. non-serialized) can be associated to products, as just an asset design. Asset designs themselves, do not get inventoried, they do not have maintenance performed against them. Only the Asset Groups or Assets will be inventoried or have maintenance.

props.label: Maintenance Cycles
props.description: Maintenance interval machine / asset cycles - based on production history for an asset instance associated to this Design - and also must be linked directly to a workcenter if tracking the workcenter as an Asset in Fuuz also, or be associated to a production run via linkage as validated asset to the run, such as a tool or fixture.
